annotation.evidence_span: A receiver MUST treat the receipt of a WINDOW_UPDATE frame with a flow-control window increment of 0 as a stream error of type PROTOCOL_ERROR; errors on the connection flow-control window MUST be treated as a connection error.
annotation.interpretation_a: The receiver must treat a WINDOW_UPDATE frame with a flow-control window increment of 0 as a stream error of type PROTOCOL_ERROR, regardless of whether the frame applies to a stream or to the connection flow-control window.
annotation.interpretation_b: The receiver must treat a WINDOW_UPDATE frame with a flow-control window increment of 0 as a stream error of type PROTOCOL_ERROR only when the frame applies to a stream; if the frame applies to the connection flow-control window, the error must be treated as a connection error.
annotation.justification: The clause contains a direct inconsistency: it simultaneously requires that a WINDOW_UPDATE frame with increment 0 be treated as a stream error and that errors on the connection flow-control window be treated as a connection error, leaving the implementation ambiguous about the correct error type when the increment 0 applies to the connection flow-control window.
